ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is at the highest of the food chain in this diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a food chain from left to right: on the far left are small aquatic organisms, with an arrow pointing to a small fish; the small fish then points through an arrow to a larger fish; the larger fish points through an arrow to a longer big fish; the final arrow points to the perched raptor on the far right. Then reason: In a food chain, the arrows successively indicate the transfer of energy or predation relationships to higher levels, and the highest level is usually the organism that is pointed to by the last arrow. In the figure, the one last pointed to by an arrow is the raptor on the far right, that is, hawk.
